actions.script: const employments = Array.from(overview.employments || []) const opened = employments.find(row => row.partyRelationshipId && row.partyRelationshipId === record.partyRelationshipId) || employments[0] || null stateColors = {current: 'positive', future: 'primary', ended: 'grey-8'} openedState = opened ? {stateText: opened.stateText, stateColor: stateColors[opened.state] || 'grey-8'} : null captionText = [employments.map(row => [row.jobTitle, row.organizationName].filter(Boolean).join(', ')).join(' · '), overview.managers?.length ? 'Reports to ' + overview.managers.map(row => row.personName).join(', ') : ''].filter(Boolean).join(' · ') employmentRows = employments // the employments the record may be opened on (the person's and HR's, each with its id), when there is a choice employmentChoices = employments.filter(row => row.partyRelationshipId).length > 1 ? employments.filter(row => row.partyRelationshipId) : [] historyRows = Array.from(historyFound?.history || []) assignmentRows = Array.from(historyFound?.assignments || []) // P6: the employment changes the user may see, the waiting ones first, and what each changes as text changeRows = Array.from(changesFound?.changes || []).slice(0, 10).map(row => Object.assign({}, row, { termsText: row.changeKindEnumId == 'EckSeparation' ? [row.terminationType, row.terminationReason].filter(Boolean).join(' · ') // a pay change's salary is opted out of AI (the user's call of Nov 12, 2026): an agent's render names none : row.isPayChange ? (row.salaryText && !sri.isAgentRender() ? 'Salary ' + row.salaryText : 'A new salary') : row.changeKindEnumId == 'EckLeave' ? (row.returnDateText ? 'Returns ' + row.returnDateText : '') : [row.departmentName, row.positionName, row.managerName ? 'manager ' + row.managerName : '', row.facilityName] .filter(Boolean).join(' · '), waitingText: row.approval?.waitingText || (row.accessFailure ? 'Access request failed: ' + row.accessFailure : ''), peopleApprovalId: row.approval?.peopleApprovalId || null, // P17: the change's lifecycle letter, HR's under People (the print of its preview is People's route) letterPrintUrl: row.letterOffered && !row.letterIssued && sharedLinks?.['Employees/EmploymentLetter'] ? '/apps/People/Employees/EmploymentLetter?renderMode=html-print&employmentChangeId=' + encodeURIComponent(row.employmentChangeId) : null, canIssueLetter: !!row.letterOffered && !row.letterIssued && !!sharedLinks?.['Employees/EmploymentLetter'] })) changeColors = {EchRequested: 'warning', EchApplied: 'positive', EchRefused: 'negative', EchSuperseded: 'grey-8', EchWithdrawn: 'grey-8'} // P7: the equipment the person holds (People's mount, the person and HR) equipmentRows = Array.from(equipmentFound?.equipmentList || []) // P18: skills, qualifications and resume lines development = developmentFound?.visible ? developmentFound : null skillRows = Array.from(development?.skills || []) qualificationRows = Array.from(development?.qualifications || []) resumeRows = Array.from(development?.resumeLines || []) // P20: the person's reviews, their state and released result reviewRows = Array.from(reviewsFound?.reviews || []) reviewStateColors = {PrvInProgress: 'primary', PrvApproval: 'warning', PrvFinalized: 'primary', PrvReleased: 'positive', PrvAcknowledged: 'positive', PrvExcluded: 'grey-8'} reviewDetailUrl = sharedLinks?.['Performance/ReviewDetail'] || null resumeTypeOptions = [{key: 'RltExperience', text: 'Experience'}, {key: 'RltEducation', text: 'Education'}, {key: 'RltOther', text: 'Other'}] qualificationsUrl = sharedLinks?.['Development/Qualifications'] || null skillsMatrixUrl = sharedLinks?.['Development/SkillsMatrix'] || null // P23: the opened employment's compensation, a payroll reader's (absent from the context's answer otherwise) compensation = regions.includes('compensation') ? record.compensation || null : null canChangePay = !!employee?.canChangePay && !!compensation?.canEdit salaryRows = Array.from(compensation?.salaries || []) payAssignmentRows = Array.from(compensation?.assignments || []) payBenefitRows = Array.from(compensation?.benefits || []) payChangeRows = Array.from(compensation?.payChanges || []) compensationFacts = compensation ? [ ['Salary', compensation.currentSalary?.salaryText || 'None in effect'], ['Pay grade', compensation.currentSalary?.payGradeName], ['Pay rate', Array.from(compensation.rates || []).map(row => row.rateText).join(', ')], ['Pay assignment', compensation.primary ? compensation.primary.structureName + ' · ' + compensation.primary.groupName + ' (' + compensation.primary.stateText + ')' : 'None'], ['Benefits', payBenefitRows.filter(row => row.state != 'ended').map(row => row.benefitText).join(', ')], ['Tax profile', compensation.profile ? (compensation.profile.hasProfile ? compensation.profile.localizationName + ', from ' + compensation.profile.fromDateText : 'None for ' + compensation.profile.localizationName) : ''], ['Readiness', compensation.readiness?.message] ].filter(([, value]) => value).map(([label, value]) => ({label, value})) : [] payChangeValues = compensation ? {partyId, partyRelationshipId: compensation.partyRelationshipId, expectedRevision: compensation.payRevision, salaryCurrencyUomId: compensation.currentSalary?.currencyUomId || null, salaryPeriodTypeId: compensation.currentSalary?.timePeriodTypeId || null, payGradeId: compensation.currentSalary?.payGradeId || null, operationKey: ec.l10n.format(ec.user.nowTimestamp, 'yyyyMMddHHmmssSSS') + '-' + (compensation.partyRelationshipId || '')} : {} payAssignmentsUrl = sharedLinks?.['Payroll/PayAssignments'] || null // P30: the clocking badge, its state and what HR may do with it; its print is a POST with the session token to People's // BadgePrint, which answers the printable badge in a window of its own (follow-up 4: a GET prints nothing) badgeShown = !!badgeFound?.canIssue || !!badgeFound?.badge kioskBadge = badgeFound?.badge || null badgeStateColors = {active: 'positive', issued: 'primary', pinNeeded: 'primary', locked: 'warning', disabled: 'negative', unprinted: 'grey-8', revoked: 'grey-8'} badgeFacts = kioskBadge ? [['Issued', kioskBadge.issuedDateText], ['Printed', kioskBadge.printedDateText], ['PIN set', kioskBadge.pinSetText], ['Last used', kioskBadge.lastUsedText]].filter(([, value]) => value).map(([label, value]) => ({label, value})) : [] badgePrintable = !!kioskBadge?.canPrint badgeValues = {partyId, partyRelationshipId: record.partyRelationshipId || null, kioskBadgeId: kioskBadge?.kioskBadgeId || null} ratesUrl = sharedLinks?.['Payroll/Rates'] || null canChangeEmployment = !!employee?.canChangeEmployment && !!record.partyRelationshipId && opened?.state != 'ended' changeEmploymentId = record.partyRelationshipId || null identificationRows = Array.from(personal.identifications || []) canEdit = editable.length > 0 // P8: the emergency contacts, in Personal information: changed by whom may change the personal information there contactOwnerPartyId = partyId contactOwnerName = overview.personName contactOpenedEmploymentId = record.partyRelationshipId || null contactRows = Array.from(personal.emergencyContacts || []) canEditContacts = canEdit canEditHr = editable.includes('firstName') personalValues = Object.assign({}, personal, personal.homeAddressFields || {}, {partyId, partyRelationshipId: record.partyRelationshipId || null, expectedRevision: personal.revision || null}) genderText = {F: 'Female', M: 'Male'}[personal.gender] || '' workRows = [['Work email', overview.workEmail], ['Work phone', overview.workPhone], ['Work address', overview.workAddress]] .filter(([, value]) => value).map(([label, value]) => ({label, value})) personalRows = [['Preferred name', personal.preferredName], ['Home phone', personal.homePhone], ['Mobile phone', personal.mobilePhone], ['Home address', personal.homeAddress], ['Birth date', personal.birthDate], ['Gender', genderText]].filter(([, value]) => value).map(([label, value]) => ({label, value})) // Insights: the return to the report (its drill's own parameters), and the person's record in People or Commons for a // user whose own grants open it insightsReturn = appRoot === 'Insights' ? ec.resource.script('component://mr-boss/service/ironstone/insights/Records.js').returnOf(ec.context) : {} ownerLink = appRoot === 'Insights' && recordFound ? ec.service.sync().name('ironstone.people.ContextServices.get#Employee360Link') .parameters({partyId}).call() : null ec.message.clearErrors()
